interpretation: The stored little-endian checksum is exactly the CRC accumulator emitted by Linux v3.0 build.c: start with 0xffffffff, process setup+protected-mode bytes and padding, then append the current state. Python zlib reports the final-XOR form: complement of the pre-checksum zlib value equals the stored word, and zlib over the full image yields ffffffff, corresponding to a no-final-XOR internal residue of zero. This corroborates the protocol convention; it does not authenticate provenance or imply the local kernel was built by this exact source revision.
